body.en: Functions describe deterministic mathematical relationships between inputs and outputs. On the ACT, questions examine function notation, domain and range restrictions, composite functions, inverse operations, and graphical transformations.
body.ar: الدوال describe deterministic mathematical relationships between inputs and outputs. On the ACT, questions examine الدالة notation, المجال and المدى restrictions, composite الدوال, inverse operations, and graphical transformations.

label.en: ● Level 1 Foundation — Function Notation, Domain & Range Restrictions
label.ar: ● Level 1 Foundation — الدالة Notation, المجال & المدى Restrictions

body.en:
A function \(f\) assigns to each input \(x\) in its domain exactly one output \(f(x)\) in its range. The vertical line test states that a curve in the coordinate plane represents a function if and only if every vertical line intersects the curve at most once.

Core Domain Restrictions on the ACT:

  • Fractions: Denominators cannot equal zero: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{g(x)} \implies g(x) \neq 0\).
  • Even Radicals: Radicands under square roots cannot be negative in the real number system: \(f(x) = \sqrt{g(x)} \implies g(x) \ge 0\).
  • Logarithms: Arguments must be strictly positive: \(f(x) = \log_b(g(x)) \implies g(x) > 0\).

Piecewise Functions: Evaluated by determining which interval contains the input \(x\) and applying the corresponding sub-function rule.
body.ar:
A function \(f\) assigns to each input \(x\) in its domain exactly one output \(f(x)\) in its range. The vertical line test states that a curve in the الإحداثي plane represents a الدالة if and only if every vertical line intersects the curve at most once.

Core المجال Restrictions on the ACT:

  • Fractions: Denominators cannot equal zero: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{g(x)} \implies g(x) \neq 0\).
  • Even Radicals: Radicands under square roots cannot be negative in the real number system: \(f(x) = \sqrt{g(x)} \implies g(x) \ge 0\).
  • Logarithms: Arguments must be strictly positive: \(f(x) = \log_b(g(x)) \implies g(x) > 0\).

Piecewise الدوال: Evaluated by determining which interval contains the input \(x\) and applying the corresponding sub-الدالة rule.

label.en: ● Level 2 Analytical Tools — Composite Functions, Inverses & Transformations
label.ar: ● Level 2 Analytical Tools — Composite الدوال, Inverses & Transformations

body.en:
Composite Functions: The composite \((f \circ g)(x) = f(g(x))\) is evaluated from the inside out: calculate \(g(x)\) first, then substitute that output value as the input for \(f\). In general, \(f(g(x)) \neq g(f(x))\).

Inverse Functions \(f^{-1}(x)\): An inverse exists if and only if \(f\) passes the horizontal line test (one-to-one). To find the inverse algebraically:

  1. Replace \(f(x)\) with \(y\).
  2. Interchange the variables \(x\) and \(y\).
  3. Solve explicitly for \(y\) in terms of \(x\).

Geometrically, the graph of \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) is the reflection of \(y = f(x)\) across the line \(y = x\).

Function Transformations \(y = a f(x - h) + k\):

  • Horizontal Shift \(h\): \(f(x - h)\) shifts the graph right by \(h\) units; \(f(x + h)\) shifts it left by \(h\) units.
  • Vertical Shift \(k\): \(f(x) + k\) shifts up by \(k\); \(f(x) - k\) shifts down by \(k\).
  • Vertical Stretch/Reflection: \(a f(x)\) stretches vertically by factor \(|a|\). If \(a < 0\), the curve reflects across the \(x\)-axis.
  • Horizontal Reflection: \(f(-x)\) reflects the curve across the \(y\)-axis.
body.ar:
Composite الدوال: The composite \((f \circ g)(x) = f(g(x))\) is evaluated from the inside out: احسب \(g(x)\) first, then عوّض that output value as the input for \(f\). In general, \(f(g(x)) \neq g(f(x))\).

Inverse الدوال \(f^{-1}(x)\): An inverse exists if and only if \(f\) passes the horizontal line test (one-to-one). To أوجد inverse algebraically:

  1. Replace \(f(x)\) with \(y\).
  2. Interchange the المتغيرات \(x\) and \(y\).
  3. Solve explicitly for \(y\) in terms of \(x\).

Geometrically, the التمثيل البياني of \(y = f^{-1}(x)\) is the reflection of \(y = f(x)\) across the line \(y = x\).

Function Transformations \(y = a f(x - h) + k\):

  • Horizontal Shift \(h\): \(f(x - h)\) shifts the التمثيل البياني right by \(h\) units; \(f(x + h)\) shifts it left by \(h\) units.
  • Vertical Shift \(k\): \(f(x) + k\) shifts up by \(k\); \(f(x) - k\) shifts down by \(k\).
  • Vertical Stretch/Reflection: \(a f(x)\) stretches vertically by factor \(|a|\). If \(a < 0\), the curve reflects across the \(x\)-axis.
  • Horizontal Reflection: \(f(-x)\) reflects the curve across the \(y\)-axis.

label.en: ● Level 3 ACT Mastery — Quadratic Vertex Form, Optimization & Rates of Change
label.ar: ● Level 3 ACT Mastery — Quadratic الرأس Form, Optimization & Rates of Change

body.en:
Quadratic Parabola Formulations:

  • Vertex Form: \[ y = a(x - h)^2 + k. \] The vertex is \((h, k)\) and the vertical axis of symmetry is \(x = h\). If \(a > 0\), the parabola opens upwards and has a minimum value of \(k\); if \(a < 0\), it opens downwards and has a maximum value of \(k\).
  • Standard Form Conversion: For \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\), the \(x\)-coordinate of the vertex is: \[ h = -\frac{b}{2a}, \quad k = f\left(-\frac{b}{2a}\right). \]
  • Factored Form: \(y = a(x - p)(x - q)\). The \(x\)-intercepts are \(p\) and \(q\), and the axis of symmetry lies exactly halfway between them: \(h = \frac{p + q}{2}\).

Average Rate of Change: The average rate of change of \(f(x)\) over an interval \([a, b]\) is the slope of the secant line:

\[ \text{Average Rate of Change} = \frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a}. \]
body.ar:
Quadratic القطع المكافئ Formulations:

  • Vertex Form: \[ y = a(x - h)^2 + k. \] The الرأس is \((h, k)\) and the vertical axis of symmetry is \(x = h\). If \(a > 0\), the القطع المكافئ opens upwards and has a minimum value of \(k\); if \(a < 0\), it opens downwards and has a maximum value of \(k\).
  • Standard Form Conversion: For \(y = ax^2 + bx + c\), the \(x\)-الإحداثي of the الرأس is: \[ h = -\frac{b}{2a}, \quad k = f\left(-\frac{b}{2a}\right). \]
  • Factored Form: \(y = a(x - p)(x - q)\). The \(x\)-intercepts are \(p\) and \(q\), and the axis of symmetry lies exactly halfway between them: \(h = \frac{p + q}{2}\).

Average Rate of Change: The average rate of change of \(f(x)\) over an interval \([a, b]\) is the الميل of the secant line:

\[ \text{Average Rate of Change} = \frac{f(b) - f(a)}{b - a}. \]

body.en:
• Order of Composition: \( (f \circ g)(x) = f(g(x)) \) means evaluate \( g(x) \) FIRST, then substitute the result into \( f \). Evaluating outside-in is one of the most common ACT distractor answer choices.
  • Domain Restrictions: Watch for two key restrictions: denominators cannot equal zero (e.g., \( \frac{1}{x-3} \implies x \neq 3 \)), and expressions under an even radical cannot be negative (e.g., \( \sqrt{2x-8} \implies 2x-8 \ge 0 \implies x \ge 4 \)).
  • Vertical Line Test vs. Horizontal Line Test: A vertical line tests whether a graph is a function (each input has at most one output). A horizontal line tests whether a function is one-to-one (has an invertible function \( f^{-1}(x) \)).
  • Function Transformations: \( f(x - c) \) shifts RIGHT by \( c \), while \( f(x + c) \) shifts LEFT by \( c \) (horizontal operations are counter-intuitive). Vertical shifts \( f(x) + c \) go UP, and \( f(x) - c \) go DOWN.

  • Domain Restrictions: Watch for two key restrictions: denominators cannot equal zero (e.g., \( \frac{1}{x-3} \implies x \neq 3 \)), and expressions under an even radical cannot be negative (e.g., \( \sqrt{2x-8} \implies 2x-8 \ge 0 \implies x \ge 4 \)).
  • Vertical Line Test vs. Horizontal Line Test: A vertical line tests whether a التمثيل البياني is a function (each input has at most one output). A horizontal line tests whether a الدالة is one-to-one (has an invertible الدالة \( f^{-1}(x) \)).

label.en: ◆ Why It Works — First-Principles Derivation (Functions & Graphs)
label.ar: ◆ لماذا تعمل هذه الطريقة رياضياً — First-Principles اشتقاق (الدوال & Graphs)

body.en:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the range to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).
body.ar:
Why Completing the Square & Log-Linearization Work: Any quadratic \(f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c\) (\(a \ne 0\)) can be rewritten by factoring \(a\) from the first two terms and adding/subtracting \((b/2a)^2\):

\[ ax^2 + bx + c = a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \]

Because \(\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 \ge 0\) for all \(x \in \mathbb{R}\), the extreme value \(k = c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\) is attained uniquely at the axis of symmetry \(x = -\frac{b}{2a}\), restricting the المدى to \([k, \infty)\) (if \(a > 0\)) and making \(f\) invertible on \(x \ge -\frac{b}{2a}\). Similarly, applying \(\ln\) to power laws \(y = ax^n\) yields \(\ln y = n\ln x + \ln a\), transforming a nonlinear curve into a straight line of gradient \(n\).

problem.en:
Let \(f(x) = x^2 - 4\) and \(g(x) = \sqrt{2x + 1}\).
(a) Find the domain of \(g(x)\).
(b) Evaluate \((f \circ g)(4)\).
(c) Find an algebraic expression for \((g \circ f)(x)\).
problem.ar:
Let \(f(x) = x^2 - 4\) and \(g(x) = \sqrt{2x + 1}\).
(a) أوجد مجال \(g(x)\).
(b) احسب قيمة \((f \circ g)(4)\).
(c) Find an algebraic العبارة الجبرية for \((g \circ f)(x)\).

solution.en:
(a) The radicand must be non-negative: \(2x + 1 \ge 0 \implies 2x \ge -1 \implies x \ge -0.5\). Domain: \([-0.5, \infty)\).

(b) Evaluate inside first: \(g(4) = \sqrt{2(4) + 1} = \sqrt{9} = 3\).
Substitute into \(f\): \(f(3) = 3^2 - 4 = 9 - 4 = 5\).
Thus \((f \circ g)(4) = 5\).

(c) Substitute \(f(x)\) as the input to \(g\):
\[ (g \circ f)(x) = g(x^2 - 4) = \sqrt{2(x^2 - 4) + 1} = \sqrt{2x^2 - 8 + 1} = \sqrt{2x^2 - 7}. \]
solution.ar:
(a) The radicand must be non-negative: \(2x + 1 \ge 0 \implies 2x \ge -1 \implies x \ge -0.5\). المجال: \([-0.5, \infty)\).

(b) احسب قيمة inside first: \(g(4) = \sqrt{2(4) + 1} = \sqrt{9} = 3\).
Substitute into \(f\): \(f(3) = 3^2 - 4 = 9 - 4 = 5\).
Thus \((f \circ g)(4) = 5\).

(c) عوّض \(f(x)\) as the input to \(g\):
\[ (g \circ f)(x) = g(x^2 - 4) = \sqrt{2(x^2 - 4) + 1} = \sqrt{2x^2 - 8 + 1} = \sqrt{2x^2 - 7}. \]

label.en: Worked Example 3.2 — Quadratic Maximum in Word Context
label.ar: مثال محلول 3.2 — Quadratic Maximum in Word Context

problem.en: A farmer has 120 feet of fencing to enclose a rectangular pen against an existing stone barn (no fencing is needed along the side against the barn). If the pen has width \(x\) feet perpendicular to the barn, what value of \(x\) maximizes the area of the pen, and what is the maximum area?
problem.ar: A farmer has 120 feet of fencing to enclose a rectangular pen against an existing stone barn (no fencing is needed along the side against the barn). If the pen has width \(x\) feet perpendicular to the barn, what value of \(x\) maximizes the المساحة of the pen, and what is the maximum المساحة?

solution.en:
1. The fencing covers two widths \(x\) and one length \(L\):
\[ 2x + L = 120 \implies L = 120 - 2x. \]

2. Form the area function \(A(x)\):
\[ A(x) = x \cdot L = x(120 - 2x) = 120x - 2x^2 = -2x^2 + 120x. \]

3. This is a parabola opening downwards with \(a = -2\) and \(b = 120\).
The maximum occurs at the vertex:
\[ x = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{120}{2(-2)} = -\frac{120}{-4} = 30\text{ feet}. \]

4. Compute the maximum area:
\[ A(30) = -2(30^2) + 120(30) = -2(900) + 3600 = -1800 + 3600 = 1800\text{ ft}^2. \]

The optimal width is 30 feet and the maximum area is 1,800 ft².
solution.ar:
1. The fencing covers two widths \(x\) and one length \(L\):
\[ 2x + L = 120 \implies L = 120 - 2x. \]

2. Form the المساحة الدالة \(A(x)\):
\[ A(x) = x \cdot L = x(120 - 2x) = 120x - 2x^2 = -2x^2 + 120x. \]

3. This is a القطع المكافئ opening downwards with \(a = -2\) and \(b = 120\).
The maximum occurs at the الرأس:
\[ x = -\frac{b}{2a} = -\frac{120}{2(-2)} = -\frac{120}{-4} = 30\text{ feet}. \]

4. Compute the maximum المساحة:
\[ A(30) = -2(30^2) + 120(30) = -2(900) + 3600 = -1800 + 3600 = 1800\text{ ft}^2. \]

The optimal width is 30 feet and the maximum المساحة is 1,800 ft².

label.en: Worked Example 4.C — Piecewise Function Evaluation at Boundary Inputs
label.ar: مثال محلول 4.C — Piecewise الدالة Evaluation at Boundary Inputs

body.en:
Let \(f(x) = \begin{cases} 2x^2 - 1 & x < 2 \\ 5x - 3 & x \geq 2 \end{cases}\). Compute \(f(-1) + f(2)\).

Solution: Since \(-1 < 2\), \(f(-1) = 2(-1)^2 - 1 = 1\). Since \(2 \geq 2\), \(f(2) = 5(2) - 3 = 7\). Thus \(f(-1) + f(2) = 1 + 7 = \mathbf{8}\).
body.ar:
Let \(f(x) = \begin{cases} 2x^2 - 1 & x < 2 \\ 5x - 3 & x \geq 2 \end{cases}\). Compute \(f(-1) + f(2)\).

Solution: Since \(-1 < 2\), \(f(-1) = 2(-1)^2 - 1 = 1\). Since \(2 \geq 2\), \(f(2) = 5(2) - 3 = 7\). وعليه \(f(-1) + f(2) = 1 + 7 = \mathbf{8}\).

label.en: Worked Example 4.D — Vertical & Horizontal Asymptotes of Rational Functions
label.ar: مثال محلول 4.D — Vertical & Horizontal خطوط التقارب of Rational الدوال

body.en:
Find the vertical and horizontal asymptotes of \(g(x) = \frac{6x - 5}{2x + 4}\).

Solution: Set denominator to zero for the vertical asymptote: \(2x + 4 = 0 \implies \mathbf{x = -2}\). Since numerator and denominator have equal degree \(1\), the horizontal asymptote is the ratio of leading coefficients: \(y = \frac{6}{2} = \mathbf{3}\).
body.ar:
أوجد vertical and horizontal خطوط التقارب of \(g(x) = \frac{6x - 5}{2x + 4}\).

Solution: Set denominator to zero for the vertical خط التقارب: \(2x + 4 = 0 \implies \mathbf{x = -2}\). Since numerator and denominator have equal degree \(1\), the horizontal خط التقارب is the ratio of leading المعاملات: \(y = \frac{6}{2} = \mathbf{3}\).

question.en: Practice 3.2: What is the domain of the function \(f(x) = \dfrac{\sqrt{x + 5}}{x - 3}\)?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Functions & Graphs): Practice 3.2: What is the domain of the function \(f(x) = \dfrac{\sqrt{x + 5}}{x - 3}\)?

solution.en:
For the radical in the numerator to be defined, the radicand must be non-negative: \(x + 5 \ge 0 \implies x \ge -5\).
For the rational expression to be defined, the denominator cannot equal zero: \(x - 3 eq 0 \implies x eq 3\).
Combining both restrictions gives \(x \ge -5\) and \(x eq 3\), or in interval notation \([-5, 3) \cup (3, \infty)\).

Combining both restrictions gives \(x \ge -5\) and \(x eq 3\), or in interval notation \([-5, 3) \cup (3, \infty)\).

question.en: What is the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) of \(f(x) = \frac{5x + 2}{3}\)?
question.ar: حل المسألة التالية في (Functions & Graphs): What is the inverse function \(f^{-1}(x)\) of \(f(x) = \frac{5x + 2}{3}\)?

solution.ar: خطوات الحل التفصيلية: Swap \(x\) and \(y\): \(x = \frac{5y + 2}{3} \implies 3x - 2 = 5y \implies f^{-1}(x) = \mathbf{\frac{3x - 2}{5}}\).

question.ar: إذا كان \( f(x) = 3x^2 - 5x + 4 \), ما قيمة \( f(-2) \)?

hints.en: To evaluate \( f(-2) \), substitute \( -2 \) for \( x \) in the function rule: \( f(-2) = 3(-2)^2 - 5(-2) + 4 \).
hints.ar: To احسب قيمة \( f(-2) \), عوّض \( -2 \) for \( x \) in the function rule: \( f(-2) = 3(-2)^2 - 5(-2) + 4 \).

hints.en: First, evaluate the exponent: \( (-2)^2 = 4 \). Next, perform the multiplications: \( 3(4) = 12 \) and \( -5(-2) = +10 \).
hints.ar: First, احسب قيمة the exponent: \( (-2)^2 = 4 \). Next, perform the multiplications: \( 3(4) = 12 \) and \( -5(-2) = +10 \).
تلميح للحل: استخدم العلاقة \(12 + 10 + 4\) لتبسيط الخطوة.

solution.en: To evaluate \( f(-2) \), substitute \( -2 \) for \( x \) in the function rule: \( f(-2) = 3(-2)^2 - 5(-2) + 4 \). First, evaluate the exponent: \( (-2)^2 = 4 \). Next, perform the multiplications: \( 3(4) = 12 \) and \( -5(-2) = +10 \). Finally, sum the terms: \( 12 + 10 + 4 = 26 \). Common errors include treating \( (-2)^2 \) as \( -4 \), which yields \( -12 + 10 + 4 = 2 \), or failing to apply the negative sign to the middle term, giving \( 12 - 10 + 4 = 6 \).
solution.ar: To احسب قيمة \( f(-2) \), عوّض \( -2 \) for \( x \) in the function rule: \( f(-2) = 3(-2)^2 - 5(-2) + 4 \). First, احسب قيمة the exponent: \( (-2)^2 = 4 \). Next, perform the multiplications: \( 3(4) = 12 \) and \( -5(-2) = +10 \). Finally, sum the terms: \( 12 + 10 + 4 = 26 \). Common errors include treating \( (-2)^2 \) as \( -4 \), which yields \( -12 + 10 + 4 = 2 \), or failing to apply the negative sign to the middle term, giving \( 12 - 10 + 4 = 6 \).

label.en: ● Master Atlas of the 9 Main Parent Functions & Universal Transformation Law
label.ar: ● الأطلس الشامل للدوال الأم التسع وقانون التحويلات الهندسية العام

body.en:
Every algebraic and elementary transcendental model is built by transforming one of the nine core parent functions via \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\), where \(|a|\) scales vertically (reflecting across the \(x\)-axis if \(a < 0\)), \(h\) shifts horizontally, and \(k\) shifts vertically:

FamilyTransformed Form \(g(x)\)DomainRange (\(a > 0\))Key Geometric Feature
Constant\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)Horizontal line, slope \(0\)
Linear\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Constant slope \(m = a\), pivot \((h, k)\)
Quadratic\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Parabola vertex \((h, k)\), axis \(x = h\)
Cubic\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Inflection center \((h, k)\), S-curve
Absolute Value\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)V-corner vertex \((h, k)\), slopes \(\pm a\)
Radical\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)Endpoint \((h, k)\), half-parabola
Rational\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), horizontal \(y = k\)
Exponential\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)Horizontal asymptote \(y = k\), anchor \((h, a+k)\)
Logarithmic\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)Vertical asymptote \(x = h\), anchor \((h+1, k)\)
body.ar:
تُبنى النماذج الجبرية والمتسامية الأساسية من خلال تطبيق التحويل القياسي \(g(x) = a\,f(x - h) + k\) على إحدى الدوال الأم التسع، حيث يتحكم \(|a|\) في التمدد الرأسي (مع انعكاس حول محور السينات إذا كان \(a < 0\))، ويمثل \(h\) الإزاحة الأفقية، و\(k\) الإزاحة الرأسية:

عائلة الدالةالصورة المحوّلة \(g(x)\)المجالالمدى (\(a > 0\))السمة الهندسية المميزة
الثابتة\(f(x) = c\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\(\{c\}\)مستقيم أفقي ميله \(0\)
الخطية\(a(x - h) + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)ميل ثابت \(m = a\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, k)\)
التربيعية\(a(x - h)^2 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)قطع مكافئ رأسه \((h, k)\) ومحوره \(x = h\)
التكعيبية\(a(x - h)^3 + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)نقطة انعطاف مركزية \((h, k)\)
القيمة المطلقة\(a|x - h| + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)رأس زاوي على شكل V عند \((h, k)\) بميلين \(\pm a\)
الجذرية\(a\sqrt{x - h} + k\)\([h, \infty)\)\([k, \infty)\)نقطة بداية \((h, k)\) ومجال مقيّد \(x \ge h\)
النسبية (المقلوب)\(\dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\)\(x \neq h\)\(y \neq k\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) وتقارب أفقي \(y = k\)
الأسية\(a \cdot 2^{x - h} + k\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)\((k, \infty)\)تقارب أفقي \(y = k\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h, a+k)\)
اللوغاريتمية\(a\ln(x - h) + k\)\((h, \infty)\)\((-\infty, \infty)\)تقارب رأسي \(x = h\) ونقطة ارتكاز \((h+1, k)\)
